observed: The author proposed three development executions only to learn the counts to pin before running the real final set. This creates repeated validation without a new code change, failure or correctness concern.
instruction: Do not start further developer runs solely to discover test counts for the freeze script. Derive actual counts from the final direct receipts/logs AFTER those commands complete; require correct selected targets/nonzero expectations and no failures, without inventing a count in advance. Preserve already-started/completed d18/d19 and any actual needed check. A new helper must not mandate an extra test execution merely to learn a number it can parse later. Keep the existing source/realPRE/POST identity rules; do not backdate PRE or relabel earlier runs as inside it. Record this concrete process improvement in the README and carry it into the next batch's final command template. No new generic framework or extra tests for this note.
